Presenting MAIN LAILA KI FULL VIDEO SONG from HULCHUL movie starring Kajol, Vinod Khanna, Ajay Devgn in lead roles, released on 4 August 1995. The song is sung by Vinod Rathod, Sadhana Sargam and music is given by Anu Malik, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song : MAIN LAILA KI
Singer : VINOD RATHOD, SADHANA SARGAM
Music Director : ANU MALIK
Lyrics : INDEEVAR
The role of Sharmili (Kajol) was originally offered to Divya Bharti but her sudden death called for Kajol to replace her.
